author: jade-cho
title: LLM accuracy CPU tests fail with HuggingFace 429 rate limit on model download
signature: 429 Too Many Requests you have reached your api rate limit|External Service

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy CPU tests / LLM accuracy CPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: HfHubHTTPError 429 Too Many Requests when downloading Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct model

key_errors:
huggingface_hub.errors.HfHubHTTPError: 429 Too Many Requests: you have reached your 'api' rate limit.
Retry after 35 seconds (0/500 requests remaining in current 300s window).
We had to rate limit your IP (4.155.215.89). To continue using our service, create a HF account or login to your existing account, and make sure you pass a HF_TOKEN
root_cause: The LLM accuracy CPU test job attempted to download the Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct model from HuggingFace Hub. The HuggingFace API returned a 429 rate-limit error because the runner IP (4.155.215.89) exhausted the anonymous API rate limit (0/500 requests remaining in the current 300s window). This is an external service throttling issue unrelated to any code changes in the PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - external rate-limiting from HuggingFace.co; depends on IP and time of day
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs after the rate-limit window expires (35 seconds per error message)
Configure HF_TOKEN in the CI runner environment to use an authenticated HuggingFace account with higher rate limits
Consider caching model downloads to avoid re-fetching on each CI run
prevention_strategies: Set HF_TOKEN as a CI secret to avoid anonymous API rate limits on HuggingFace Hub. Implement model caching to avoid re-downloading models on every run.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of this specific HuggingFace rate-limit pattern in the MQ CI database.
